entries.what: Labor Day, no school. Isabel sleeps in, then does her dishes and checks that Lola Cora takes her lunch while Ramón is on a dispatch shift.
entries.outcome: Quiet day, chores done.

entries.what: Family picnic at Delgado Park in the afternoon with Grace, Ramón and Lola Cora. Isabel rolls her eyes at Grace's questions about the college list but eats the pancit.
entries.outcome: Got through the picnic without a fight.

entries.what: At midnight Isabel rereads her marsh personal statement, still at draft 4 and unseen by anyone, and tweaks the opening line on Ramón's old desktop.
entries.outcome: Changed three words and did not share it.

entries.what: Walks to school, then goes to the first robotics meeting of the new schedule in room C7, 3:30 to 6.
entries.outcome: Got her subteam assignment sketched out.

entries.what: After robotics she eats dinner late, does her calc problem set at the kitchen table, and runs through two practice SAT sections.
entries.outcome: Finished homework around 11.

entries.what: Isabel goes to bed around 1 a.m. with the alarm set for 6:50.
entries.outcome: Short night as usual.

entries.what: School day with APUSH and AP Chem under Mr. Ostrowski. She skips Cloud Nine at lunch to save money.
entries.outcome: Normal day.

entries.what: Before her first tutoring session she asks the assistant for a fun way to teach fractions with pizza drawings. Then she tutors Mateo, a Kessler Middle seventh-grader, 4 to 5 for $20, and sets the money aside toward her $160 application-fee fund.
entries.outcome: First session went well and Mateo laughed at the pizza slices.

entries.what: Does dishes, then reads for APUSH on her bed.
entries.outcome: Chapter done.

entries.what: Robotics in C7 runs 3:30 to 6. She and Lucas argue over a drivetrain gear ratio.
entries.outcome: Her ratio was tested and kept for now.

entries.what: At home she pastes an essay paragraph into a draft and cuts a sentence, then sets up a college-only email address so Grace cannot see messages in the family inbox.
entries.outcome: New email address ready for college mail.

entries.what: Ramón is off shift and takes her driving in the Ruel Road lots for an hour.
entries.outcome: Practiced parallel parking, no cones hit.

entries.what: Asks the assistant about managing her week. When the answer runs long about time management she cuts it off with 'ok i didn't ask for a TED talk'.
entries.outcome: Got a short version instead.

entries.what: Ms. Lugo reads one draft per student on Fridays, so Isabel gets her turn with a different assignment instead of the personal statement, which she is not ready to show.
entries.outcome: Got feedback on a class essay, kept the statement hidden.

entries.what: Goes to the Egrets home football opener with Nadia, who takes yearbook photos from the stands.
entries.outcome: Egrets game was loud, and Nadia got her shots.

entries.what: Spends Saturday morning at the library with Harper for SAT prep, 10 to 12, timing each section with the kitchen timer.
entries.outcome: Math section went better than reading.

entries.what: Afternoon at the homework center working on her snow list, then walks home past the marsh and photographs egrets for her tally.
entries.outcome: Added two sightings to her notebook.

entries.what: Dinner at home, then Isabel and Nadia text late about colleges.
entries.outcome: Bed late.

entries.what: Goes with Lola Cora and Grace to Tagalog Mass at 9, then Lola Cora cooks sinigang for Sunday lunch.
entries.outcome: Ate the sinigang and pretended not to care much.

entries.what: Grace grades at the table while Isabel does a practice SAT section nearby. They talk about essays and Isabel gives short answers.
entries.outcome: Tense but no fight.

entries.what: Evening homework and dishes, then she reworks her college list spreadsheet before bed.
entries.outcome: Ready for the week.
